mapper.sql: select p.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.product_spec, p.unit_name, p.bar_code, p.category_name, p.brand_name, p.product_image, p.cost_price, p.sale_price, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from md_product p left join sys_user su on su.user_name = p.create_by and su.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where (p.bar_code = #{scanCode} or p.product_code = #{scanCode}) and (p.del_flag is null or p.del_flag = '0') order by case when p.bar_code = #{scanCode} then 0 else 1 end limit 1
mapper.insert:

mapper.select: select (select count(1) from wms_stock where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_stock_log where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_purchase_order_item where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from md_customer_price where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_sale_order_item where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_sale_return_item where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_purchase_return_item where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_outbound_item where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_inbound_item where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_inventory_check_item where product_id = #{productId}) + (select count(1) from wms_transfer_item where product_id = #{productId})
mapper.delete:
delete from md_product where product_id in
#{productId}
mapper.select: select count(distinct soi.sale_order_id) as saleOrderCount, ifnull(sum(soi.quantity), 0) as totalSaleQty, ifnull(sum(soi.amount), 0) as totalSaleAmount from wms_sale_order_item soi join wms_sale_order so on so.sale_order_id = soi.sale_order_id where soi.product_id = #{productId} and so.status = 'audited'

select count(distinct sri.sale_return_id) as returnCount, ifnull(sum(sri.quantity), 0) as returnQty, ifnull(sum(sri.amount), 0) as returnAmount from wms_sale_return_item sri join wms_sale_return sr on sr.sale_return_id = sri.sale_return_id where sri.product_id = #{productId} and sr.status = 'audited'

select count(distinct poi.purchase_order_id) as purchaseOrderCount, ifnull(sum(poi.quantity), 0) as totalPurchaseQty, ifnull(sum(poi.amount), 0) as totalPurchaseAmount from wms_purchase_order_item poi join wms_purchase_order po on po.purchase_order_id = poi.purchase_order_id where poi.product_id = #{productId} and po.status in ('1', '2', '3')

select st.stock_id as stockId, st.warehouse_id as warehouseId, ifnull(mw.warehouse_name, concat('仓库#', st.warehouse_id)) as warehouseName, st.location_id as locationId, ifnull(ml.location_name, concat('库位#', st.location_id)) as locationName, st.batch_no as batchNo, ifnull(st.quantity, 0) as quantity, ifnull(st.locked_quantity, 0) as lockedQuantity, ifnull(st.frozen_quantity, 0) as frozenQuantity, st.warning_min_qty as warningMinQty, st.warning_max_qty as warningMaxQty from wms_stock st left join md_warehouse mw on mw.warehouse_id = st.warehouse_id left join md_location ml on ml.location_id = st.location_id where st.product_id = #{productId} order by st.quantity desc, st.stock_id asc
